title: Monte Carlo Tree Diffusion with Multiple Experts for Protein Design (MCTD-ME)
relevance: Directly combines MCTS with masked diffusion for protein design. Proposes PH-UCT-ME selection rule extending entropy-based UCT to expert ensembles. Core reference for this concept card.
key_finding: Masked diffusion denoising as rollout engine enables multi-token planning and efficient exploration, outperforming single-expert autoregressive planners on CAMEO and PDB benchmarks.

title: Tree Search-Based Evolutionary Bandits for Protein Sequence Optimization
relevance: Tree search + bandit learning for protein engineering with GP prior and Bayesian regret bounds. Provides theoretical justification for tree-based mutation search.
key_finding: Tree search with bandit guidance can efficiently discover near-optimal protein designs with provable Bayesian regret bounds.

title: Octopus Inspired Optimization (OIO): A Hierarchical Framework for Navigating Protein Fitness Landscapes
relevance: Hierarchical metaheuristic mimicking octopus neural architecture for protein engineering. Surpassed 15 competing metaheuristics. Demonstrates value of hierarchical exploration in protein fitness landscapes.
key_finding: Centralized global exploration + parallelized local exploitation outperforms 15 metaheuristics on protein engineering benchmarks.
